item.title: Fast Cantor Expansion
item.description: The Fast Cantor Expansion is an algorithm that finds the lexicographical rank of a permutation p_0,p_1,\dots,p_{n-1} of \{0,1,\dots,n-1\} among all permutations of \{0,1,\dots,n-1\} in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Inverse Fast Cantor Expansion
item.description: The Inverse Fast Cantor Expansion is an algorithm that finds the k-th lexicographically smallest permutation of \{0,1,\dots,n-1\} in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Binary Search
item.description: Binary Search is an algorithm that counts the number of true values in a sequence of n booleans f_0,f_1,\dots,f_{n-1} satisfying \forall i\in\{1,2,\dots,n-1\},f_i\Rightarrow f_{i-1} in \mathcal{O}(\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Boyer-Moore Majority Vote Algorithm
item.description: The Boyer-Moore Majority Vote Algorithm is an algorithm that finds the majority of a sequence of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1}, if the majority exists, in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Bubble Sort
item.description: Bubble Sort is an algorithm that sorts a sequence of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n^2) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Counting Sort
item.description: Counting Sort is an algorithm that sorts a sequence of n integers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1}\in\{0,1,\dots,m-1\} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n+m) time and \mathcal{O}(m) space.

item.title: Heapsort
item.description: Heapsort is an algorithm that sorts a sequence of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n\log n) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.

item.title: Insertion Sort
item.description: Insertion Sort is an algorithm that sorts a sequence of n numbers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(n^2) time and \mathcal{O}(1) space.
